$clipData = Get-Clipboard -Raw
$regex = 'https://static\.bandlab\.com/[^\s"''><]+?\.mp3'
$urls = [regex]::Matches($clipData, $regex) | ForEach-Object { $_.Value } | Select-Object -Unique
if ($urls.Count -eq 0) { Write-Host "Clipboard was empty or didn't have the links. Try copying from BandLab again!" -ForegroundColor Red } else {
    Write-Host "Found $($urls.Count) files! Downloading..." -ForegroundColor Green
    $folder = "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads"; $c = 1
    foreach ($u in $urls) {
        $name = $u -split '/' | Select-Object -Last 1
        Write-Host "[$c/$($urls.Count)] Saving: $name" -ForegroundColor Cyan
        try { Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u -OutFile (Join-Path $folder $name) -ErrorAction Stop } catch {}
        $c++
    }
    Write-Host "Done! Check your Downloads folder." -ForegroundColor Green
}
